name: github
description: GitHub repository administration through the gh CLI — create a new repository from your own template and configure it step by step, or audit an existing one against the same baseline and fix what you approve: merge methods, head-branch cleanup, Dependabot alerts and security updates, secret and code scanning, Actions token permissions, and a default-branch ruleset with required status checks that really run and the bypass your release bot needs. Every decision is proposed and approved before anything is written.
